params_in_policy_record.chain_join: collinear within eps_n both ways; end points coincident within eps_n (touching); same occurrence path; TOPOLOGY_BOUNDARY on both sides; NO opening / glazing segment end within eps_r of the joint (OPENING_BREAK). A gap of any size, including inside the 50 mm review band, is never joined
params_in_policy_record.duplicate: collinear fragments overlapping by more than eps_n are ONE chain with a DUPLICATE interval; a span over a duplicate interval is AMBIGUOUS
params_in_policy_record.elongation_basis: the raw overlap of the two CHAINS (never a sub-interval)
params_in_policy_record.local_mutual_nearest: evaluated at the middle of every elementary interval (breakpoints: projections of all parallel overlapping chains of both chains, both sides)
params_in_policy_record.nearest_tie: eps_r (a tie between two chains is never paired)
params_in_policy_record.strip: a label anywhere in the RAW strip of the chain pair (the whole chain overlap) rejects the pair - local pairing must never turn an unlabelled slice of a room into a band; labels or arcs in the local strip reject the run; crossings subdivide it
params_in_policy_record.pair_search: exhaustive over admitted faces (no direction buckets, no neighbourhood window)
params_in_policy_record.review_band: role_authority.NEAR_MISS_REVIEW_BAND_MM / unit - cap grading only, never a join
